name: Progress
description: A determinate progress bar: a sunken full-width track with a brand-colored fill whose width is data-driven ({{pct}}, a percentage string like "62%"). Owns its full style — references tokens only.
whenToUse: Show completion of a known-length task or quota (upload, steps done, budget used). Compose via a Ref, remapping the pct binding to the host's percentage field; the data producer supplies a resolved percentage string.
